1. Engagement Scope

This compliance assessment was initiated as part of Esquire Advisory Group's pre-transaction due diligence for a planned acquisition in the Counter-Drone Technology sector. The scope covers 220 material compensation and benefits programs across 3 legal entities, focusing on potential liabilities and integration risks.

2. Methodology

A "document-request-list" simulation was used, mirroring a typical request from a regulatory agency like the DOL or EEOC. Esquire Advisory Group's ability to produce the requested 220 documents within a 14-day timeframe was assessed.

4. Detailed Findings
EQR-5385-001LOWMONITORING
Observation

Commission plan agreements for 220 sales employees are not in writing as required by state law

Corrective Action Required

The company will implement a centralized system for tracking all employee complaints of harassment, discrimination, and retaliation, ensuring all investigations are conducted and documented in a timely and consistent manner.

Management Response

This finding has been remediated as of the report date. Supporting documentation, including revised policy language and employee acknowledgment records, has been provided to ACPWB under separate cover. {org} requests formal closure of this item.

Owner: Manager of Total Rewards Programs • Due: 1985-07-28
EQR-5831-002INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

ERISA plan documents not furnished to 220 participants within 30 days of written request

Corrective Action Required

The benefits administration platform will be reconfigured to prevent plan loans that do not conform to the specific terms of the 401(k) plan document.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Risk Analyst • Due: 1985-06-28
EQR-1931-003LOWOPEN
Observation

Salary range disclosure missing from 13% of job postings in jurisdictions requiring it

Corrective Action Required

The Compensation Committee charter will be amended to explicitly assign responsibility for overseeing the enforcement of the company's executive compensation clawback policy.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Director of Channel Partnerships • Due: 1985-07-28
EQR-1830-004LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

401(k) plan loan administration not in compliance with plan document provisions for 220 participants

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

This finding relates to a legacy system that is scheduled for decommissioning on 1985-04-20. Given the impending system retirement, management has accepted the risk for the interim period and will not invest in remediation for the legacy system.

Owner: Chief Communications Officer • Due: 1985-06-28
EQR-6061-005LOWMONITORING
Observation

Offer letter language inconsistent with executed employment agreements for 220 hires

Corrective Action Required

Perform a root cause analysis of the EEO-1 Component 2 data errors and implement validation controls in the data preparation process to prevent recurrence in future reporting cycles.

Management Response

Management acknowledges the finding and has initiated a preliminary review. The designated owner will oversee remediation. Esquire Advisory Group requests a 30-day extension to the original due date to allow for thorough analysis across all affected locations.

Owner: Senior Director of Stakeholder Engagement • Due: 1985-06-28
EQR-6705-006MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

Pregnancy Discrimination Act (PDA) accommodation process is not formally documented or consistently applied

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

The finding is valid and has been added to our compliance remediation backlog. It has been prioritized for action in the next fiscal quarter, subject to resource availability.

Owner: Senior Manager of Financial Analysis • Due: 1985-07-28
EQR-6030-007LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Employee handbook contains policies that could be construed as chilling NLRA-protected concerted activity

Corrective Action Required

The annual open enrollment communications package will be updated to include the most current HIPAA privacy notice as a mandatory acknowledgment item for all enrolling employees.

Management Response

Management concurs with the finding and has already initiated corrective action independent of this review. The designated owner will provide written confirmation of full remediation no later than the due date specified above.
